caption:
Material study — oak, marble & burgundy.

In the villa's living and dining room, light oak shelving and fins meet a veined marble column, greige wall panels and charcoal leather, with one deep burgundy artwork as the accent. Warm, restrained and made to age well.

Save it as a reference for your own palette.
